releaseNotes:
• TelephonyManager PhoneStateListener: Continuous real-time detection of incoming phone calls
• Modern TelephonyCallback API integration on Android 12+ (API 31+)
• Floating Caller ID Window: Truecaller-style floating popup with 2D touch drag handle
• Interactive Actions: Open Details, 1-tap Quick Block & Report, and instant Dismiss
• In-App Live Overlay Tester in Settings: Preview verified caller & spam alerts directly
• Permanent Cryptographic Release Signing: Unified release keystore preventing signature mismatches
• Package Name Alignment: Verified package com.aistudio.detectcaller.qkcall
• Enhanced 120 FPS AMOLED Dark theme with battery optimizations
